verdict.rationale: Superpowers documents its own long-running autonomous execution: once the user says "go", subagent-driven development works through plan tasks, reviews them, and continues, sometimes for hours. However, this is a one-off, user-initiated session run that still stops for approval before implementation, not a recurring schedule or event-triggered background automation. Missing for 10: configurable automations, scheduled or recurring runs, event triggers, true background or detached execution, and independent corroboration of unattended operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: It's not uncommon for your agent to work autonomously for a couple hours at a time
Non-catastrophic conflicts and ambiguities get a recorded ruling and work continues; only destructive or irreversible actions still stop for a human.
Every path still stops for your approval before implementation.
